# Release v3.3.0

<!-- Generated by cidx on 2026-08-20 17:18 -->
<!-- Edit this file to customize your release notes -->

## What changes for you

- **`cidx run build` now produces a portable binary.** The Go build preset pins
  `CGO_ENABLED=0`, so the artifact no longer links against the build image's
  libc. Before this, a binary built on the Alpine-based image would not start on
  Debian or Ubuntu — and said `not found` about a file that was plainly there.
  [What Leaves the Container](docs/core-concepts/artifacts-across-containers.md)
  explains the trap and how to read it.
- **A container can refuse to be reused**, for the ones that write to their own
  filesystem: `ephemeral = true` in `[containers.<name>]`. `probatum` ships it.
  Every key that section accepts is now listed in
  [Container Options](docs/reference/container-options.md).
- **`cidx run --dry-run` no longer needs a container runtime.** It describes the
  pipeline wherever it is asked, including where nothing could have run.

## ✨ Features

- **config:** let a container declare it must not be reused (#435)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **security:** gate the audit on what needs a human, not on every finding (#436)
- **run:** let a dry run answer where nothing can run (#427)
- **presets:** build an artifact that runs where the user runs it (#423)

## 📚 Documentation

- **core-concepts:** explain the "not found" that names the wrong file (#425)
